question: Who is often referred to as the "Mother of Modern Bharatanatyam"?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rukmini Devi Arundale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was born on February 29, 1904, in **Madurai, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• She played a pivotal role in reviving and promoting **Bharatanatyam**, a classical Indian dance form.
 
• Rukmini Devi founded the** Kalakshetra Foundation in 1936 in Chennai.**
 
• She was the **first woman** in Indian history to be **nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• She has also been awarded the **Padma Bhushan, **one of India's highest civilian honor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mallika Sarabhai **was Born on May 9, 1954, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
 
• She was a noted performer of **Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam.**
 
• Recipient of the** Padma Bhushan and the French Palme D'**or for her contributions to the arts.
 
• **Sanjukta Panigrahi** was the foremost exponent of the Indian classical dance form **Odissi.**
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai** was a multifaceted artist, Mrinalini was trained in** Bharatanatyam, Kathakali, and Mohiniyattam.**
 
• **Founded the Darpana Academy **of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad in 1949.
 
• She received many accolades for her contributions, including the** Padma Shri in 1965 and the Padma Bhushan in 1992.**
